name: get_device_detail
description: Fetch one device/group's FULL specification: real property/command/parameter ids, plus each one's uom, precision, min/max, and enum key/label pairs. DEVICE DATABASE deliberately omits all of this (names only, to stay compact) -- call this tool for every device you're about to reference in create_or_update_routine's DSL, before writing any status()/was_controlled()/command()/param() call for it. Not needed for get_property/send_command, which already resolve names on the backend -- this tool exists specifically because the routine DSL needs the raw ids/uom/precision itself, not a name the backend can resolve for it.

device_id.description: The device/group's real id, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE.
